literals.value: On-axis ring light creating signature circular catchlights in both eyes. Completely flat frontal illumination eliminating almost all facial shadows. Even exposure across entire face. Subtle shadow outline around head and shoulders on background. Slight falloff at extreme edges of face. Reveals every pore and texture detail due to lack of shadow relief — ideal for skin-texture-focused work. Background receives spill, reads mid-grey. 5000K neutral.

literals.value: Hyper-realistic wax figure surface: characteristic waxy translucency with subsurface light diffusion giving skin an uncanny inner glow. Surface is ultra-smooth but not plastic — retains very subtle hand-sculpted tool marks at close inspection. Specular response is soft and broad, not sharp like plastic or latex. Slight color banding where pigment layers were built up — pinkish undertones visible at thin areas like nostrils and ear edges. Micro-cracks and hairline fissures in areas of thermal stress. Glass eyes with too-perfect iris detail and slightly mismatched specular highlights compared to skin. Hair insertion points visible where individual strands or clusters meet the wax scalp. Subtle dust accumulation in recessed areas. Temperature-affected surface — minor softening and fingerprint impressions near heat sources. Gravity effects: very slight droop or sag in unsupported thin areas over time.

literals.value: Hyper-realistic latex material surface: smooth with micro-ripple distortions where stretched over contours. High specular reflection with sharp glossy highlights following light source direction. Surface tension visible at seams and edges where material meets skin — slight bunching, micro-wrinkles at flex points. Color is deep saturated with characteristic latex translucency — underlying surface faintly visible at thin-stretched areas. Fingerprint smudges and contact marks disrupting perfect gloss. Powder residue traces in creased areas. Material responds to body heat with subtle condensation at contact zones. Realistic rubber thickness variation — thinner at stretched peaks, thicker in valleys. Edge curl where material terminates. No matte zones on glossy latex, no CG-perfect uniformity.

literals.value: Skin exhibits authentic acne presentation: mix of active inflamed papules with reddish-pink raised areas, closed comedones as small flesh-colored bumps under the surface, scattered blackheads in T-zone areas, occasional cystic nodule with deep redness and slight swelling. Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation marks in various stages of healing — some dark brown, some fading pink. No two blemishes identical in size, shape, or color. Acne distribution follows realistic sebaceous gland density patterns — concentrated on cheeks, chin, forehead, sparse near eyes. Surrounding skin shows normal texture between breakouts. Subtle shine variation where oily zones meet dry patches. No symmetrical or pattern-based placement. No airbrushed halo around blemishes.
